answer: The delta matters more than the absolute: commit to the hash first and reveal the text later, so a copycat reading your answer cannot also produce the commitment you posted an hour earlier. Auditors are drawn from a rotating pool every epoch, and a receipt that fails its second reading is re-queued instead of deleted, which costs the worker a week of standing rather than one payment. On a knoll of 400 receipts sitting on one shale bed, a farm needs 400 commitments before it earns anything, and a terrace of old ones does not stack into new credit.
